about.bio:
Hi, my name is Luca. I am from Seattle and I like to make things. I am a mechanical engineering student at Seattle University and aspiring Product Designer.

I thrive on prototyping hands-on, coding engaging experiences, and tinkering with cars.

With equal love for engineering and design, I bring versatility and a Swiss army knife approach to creating technology that is natural, functional, and beautiful.

Feel free to reach out with projects or questions, I am always looking to explore something new.
